items.headline: Drake Maye rebounds as Patriots hand Bills first defeat
items.description: Drake Maye snapped out of his early-season slide with a clutch performance as the New England Patriots upset the Buffalo Bills, 29-26, at Highmark Stadium in a result that coach Mike Vrabel highlighted as critical for the defending AFC champions.

items.headline: Maye overcomes his two turnovers with 3 TD passes in Patriots' 29-26 win over Bills
items.description: — Drake Maye threw three touchdown passes, including Efton Chism’s one-handed catch with 1:50 remaining, and the New England Patriots defeated the Buffalo Bills 29-26 on Sunday.
